name: web-pixel-art-hero-agent-platform-landing
title: Pixel-Art Landscape Hero Landing Page
whatItIs: A landing page whose entire hero is a lush pixel-art park scene with a laptop and notebook on the grass, floating task-status chips and glass nav pills, ending in a pixelated grass edge before a clean white section with logos and a diagram.
whatItMeans: Nostalgic game art makes an abstract idea like running a company with AI feel playful and approachable. The clean section beneath returns to sober credibility.
techniques: Full-bleed pixel-art scene as the hero
Frosted glass nav pills over the illustration
Floating status chips in the scene that hint at the product
Pixelated dissolve edge as the transition to the clean section
Muted gray diagram below to contrast with the saturated hero
bestFor: Indie and AI tools wanting personality

vocabulary.definition: Illustration built from visible square pixels.
A scattered, broken border between two sections.
